r0c2.en: <align="left">Demonic Trials: Challenge powerful remnants of Degenerates within the Shaolin Sect to hone your martial arts and claim the rewards.</align>
r0c2.cn: <align="left">诛魔试炼：在少林派内挑战强大的魔头残影，磨炼自身武艺，并获取相应的奖励。</align>

r0c3.en: <align="left">Arhat Enlightenment: Use the Arhat Statues obtained from Demonic Trials to comprehend mechanism.\nSeek Enlightenment: Consumes XP to increase the Capacity Cap or Connection Success Rate for your next Breakthrough.</align>
r0c3.cn: <align="left">罗汉开悟：使用诛魔试炼获得的罗汉像参悟玄机。\n请求开悟：消耗历练，以增加下一次突破时的天资上限或连接成功率。</align>

r1c2.en: <align="left">Unique Mind Method: Assist the White Ape in researching Unique Mind Methods to bestow additional special effects upon Taiwu's martial arts.</align>
r1c2.cn: <align="left">独创心法：帮助白猿钻研独创心法，为太吾的功法赋予额外的特殊效果。</align>

r1c3.en: <align="left">Can comprehend 2 Unique Mind Methods for each martial art.</align>
r1c3.cn: <align="left">每门功法能够同时领悟2项独创心法。</align>
r1c3.ru: <align="left">Может постичь 2 уникальных мысленных метода для каждого Боевой техники.</align>

r2c2.en: <align="left">Life and Death: Place characters into Life Poses and Death Poses. The character in the Death Pose will continuously restore Health for the one in the Life Pose\u002c granting positive or negative traits.</align>
r2c2.cn: <align="left">生关死节：将不同的人物分别置于生位和死位，令死位人物持续为生位人物补充健康，并获得相应的正面或负面特性。</align>

r2c3.en: <align="left">The number of Life Poses and Death Poses increases to 8 each.</align>
r2c3.cn: <align="left">生位、死位的数量增加至各8个。</align>
r2c3.ru: <align="left">Количество поз жизни и смерти увеличивается до 8 в каждой.</align>

r3c2.en: <align="left">Correcting and Reversing: Consumes XP to modify the Outlines and Chapter Mind Method types of Martial Arts books.</align>
r3c2.cn: <align="left">改正修逆：消耗历练，以修改功法书籍的总纲和篇章心法类型。</align>

r3c3.en: <align="left">Altering Acupoints: During Breakthrough\u002c you can consume XP to swap the positions of any two Breakthrough nodes\u002c excluding the Starting Point and Goal Node.</align>
r3c3.cn: <align="left">移宫易穴：在突破过程中，可以消耗历练，交换除起点和终点外的任意两个突破格的位置。</align>

r4c2.en: <align="left">Trinity Protection/Three Demons Disrupting Array: Deploy the Trinity or Three Demons as Support Companions in battle. The Trinity and Three Demons each possess unique Support Commands.</align>
r4c2.cn: <align="left">三才护阵/三魔乱阵：可令三才或三魔作为助战同道出战，三才、三魔各自具有特殊的助战指令。</align>

r4c3.en: <align="left">The maximum number of Trinity/Three Demons deployed as Support Companions increases from 1 to 3.</align>
r4c3.cn: <align="left">三才/三魔作为我方助战同道的数量上限从1名增加至3名。</align>

r5c2.en: <align="left">Comprehensive Strategy: Strike the Lion's Drum at Lion-Face Clan to inspire companions and enhance their Support Commands.</align>
r5c2.cn: <align="left">统筹方略：在狮相门擂响狮子战鼓鼓舞同道，强化同道的助战指令。</align>

r5c3.en: <align="left">The maximum number of each character's Advanced Commands increases to 2.</align>
r5c3.cn: <align="left">每名人物可拥有的高级指令数量增加至2个。</align>
r5c3.ru: <align="left">Максимальное количество расширенных команд каждого персонажа увеличивается до 2.</align>

r6c2.en: <align="left">Entrust Secret Tomes: Entrust the secret tomes held by Taiwu to the Three Corpses to prevent others from seizing them.\nSever Tome Attachment: Order the Three Corpses to follow characters who hold secret tomes\u002c enticing them to give them up.</align>
r6c2.cn: <align="left">寄托奇书：将太吾持有的奇书寄托于三尸处，以避免他人前来争夺奇书。\n奇书断执：令三尸跟随持有奇书的人物，诱使其放弃奇书。</align>

r6c3.en: <align="left">The number of secret tomes each Three Demons can be entrusted with increases to 4.</align>
r6c3.cn: <align="left">每名三尸可寄托的奇书增加至4本。</align>

r7c2.en: <align="left">Music Box: Collect music scores from all over the world to increase Taiwu's Drive and Integrity.\nCreation of Life: Utilize the power of Egarim to create a character who looks strikingly similar to Taiwu himself.</align>
r7c2.cn: <align="left">《孤鸾镜水谣》：通过收集世界各地的曲谱，提升太吾的动心、守心。\n造化生人：可借助一明珏之力，创造出与太吾本人极为相似的人物。</align>

r7c3.en: <align="left">Outer Realms Travel: Introduce a child into the mirror for an adventure. Upon their return\u002c they will reach 16 years of age and their traits will be significantly improved.</align>
r7c3.cn: <align="left">天外游历：引荐一名孩童入镜游历，归来时立即成长至16岁，并大幅改善特性。</align>

r8c2.en: <align="left">Dubhe's Arcane Forging: Obtain an Automaton companion. This companion has a unique way of growth and can be deployed as a Support Companion in battle who possesses unique Support Commands.</align>
r8c2.cn: <align="left">天枢玄铸：获得机关人同道，此同道拥有特殊的成长方式，并可作为助战同道出战，拥有特殊的助战指令。</align>

r8c3.en: <align="left">Obtain one extra Automaton companion\u002c who possesses different unique Support Commands.</align>
r8c3.cn: <align="left">额外获得一名机关人同道，拥有不同的特殊助战指令。</align>

r9c2.en: <align="left">Command the Ancient Ding: At the cost of consuming all of Taiwu's Health\u002c drive the Ancient Ding to a designated region to continuously provide healing for all characters there.</align>
r9c2.cn: <align="left">驱使古鼎：以消耗太吾的所有健康为代价，驱使古鼎前往指定地区，为此地区的所有人物持续提供治疗。</align>

r9c3.en: <align="left">Tempered by Ding Jiao: Consumes Prime Gu to remove the Blackstone Ash trait from characters in the Ancient Ding's region\u002c making them immune to Blackstone Ash erosion for 10 years.</align>
r9c3.cn: <align="left">鼎蛟淬身：消耗王蛊，为古鼎所在地区的人物移除玄灰特性，并使其在10年内免受玄灰侵染。</align>

r10c2.en: <align="left">Soul Transformation Ritual: Merge souls from Reincarnation Platform into another's body to achieve rebirth.</align>
r10c2.cn: <align="left">化魂仪式：将轮回台的魂魄融入他人的躯体中，以此获得重生。</align>

r10c3.en: <align="left">During Soul Transformation Ritual\u002c a single body can concurrently merge with up to three souls.</align>
r10c3.cn: <align="left">在化魂仪式中，可将一具躯体同时与最多3名魂魄进行融合。</align>

r11c2.en: <align="left">Refine Prime Gu: Use poison reagents to refine Prime Gu\u002c which is a special type of Gu that has more powerful effects and more versatile uses compared to normal Gu.</align>
r11c2.cn: <align="left">炼制王蛊：用毒物引子炼制王蛊，王蛊是一种特殊蛊虫，相较于普通蛊虫效果更强、使用方式更灵活。</align>

r11c3.en: <align="left">Activate Prime Gu: Drive the Prime Gu within a character's body with Gu Immortal's Power to produce immediate positive or negative effects.</align>
r11c3.cn: <align="left">驱动王蛊：可借助蛊仙之力驱动人物体内的王蛊，以产生正面或负面的即时效果。</align>

r12c2.en: <align="left">Astral Dou: Kill other characters to seize their Star Fortune\u002c which can be used to gain Legacy bonuses before the Taiwu Inheritance is performed.</align>
r12c2.cn: <align="left">奇纹星斗：可杀死其他人物以夺取其星运，星运可用于在尚未进行太吾传承时获取生平遗惠加成。</align>

r12c3.en: <align="left">The construction cap for "Astral Terraces" increases to 10.</align>
r12c3.cn: <align="left">「奇纹星台」的建造总数上限增加至10座。</align>
r12c3.ru: <align="left">Ограничение на строительство для "Астральных террас" увеличивается до 10.</align>

r13c2.en: <align="left">Chicken Dispatch: Dispatch the chickens of Taiwu Village to assist villagers\u002c helping them fulfill their Professions.</align>
r13c2.cn: <align="left">调遣元鸡：调遣太吾村的元鸡协助村民，帮助其更好地履行村民身份职能。</align>

r13c3.en: <align="left">Spiritual Chicken Feathers: Chickens in Taiwu Village will continuously grow chicken feathers for Taiwu to gather.</align>
r13c3.cn: <align="left">元鸡灵羽：太吾村中的元鸡会不断长出元鸡羽，以供太吾收获。</align>

r14c2.en: <align="left">Jixi Companion: Order Jixi to follow Taiwu to eliminate outlaws and vigilantes nearby\u002c and restore Health for Taiwu.</align>
r14c2.cn: <align="left">姬穸随行：可令姬穸跟随太吾，消灭太吾附近的外道与任侠，并为太吾恢复健康。</align>

r14c3.en: <align="left">Jixi's act of Kill and Drink Blood will change to absorbing others' True Qi.\nAbsorb Qi with Seal: Jixi can assist with transferring Elemental Qi and exchanging True Qi with Taiwu.</align>
r14c3.cn: <align="left">姬穸杀人饮血的行为将变为吸食他人真气。\n持印汲气：姬穸可以协助太吾转移内力五行，并与太吾相互传输真气。</align>
